full_prompt_en: A square semi-abstract painting sets a small cluster of yellow flowers beside a large orange disk amid rough blocks of saturated color. A deep cobalt-blue field covers much of the left and upper background. At the far left, a tall mustard-yellow strip is interrupted by scratches, blue marks, and a thick black horizontal band. On the right half, a broad pink rectangle rises behind the central elements, its edge partly scraped back to reveal blue beneath. Across the middle, irregular black and dark navy strokes run horizontally, making a heavy shadowed bar. Thin dark green stems emerge from the lower center and carry several bright yellow-orange blossoms with small black centers. Their petals are thick, simplified, and partly broken by the surrounding paint, so the flowers sit between recognizable still life and pure color marks. A large flat orange disk occupies the right middle, its slightly rough edge brushing against the pink and dark fields. Below it, a pale white block spreads through the lower right. Blue smears, faint linear scratches, and narrow black accents cut into the white, preventing it from becoming a pristine rectangle. The lower left returns to strong blue, with olive-green stem shapes descending in front. The surface is visibly layered: dragged pigment, scraped patches, uneven opacity, and pencil-like guide lines remain apparent across the broad fields. There is no deep perspective or readable writing; the elements stand close to one painted plane. Light is graphic and even, with value contrast between white, yellow, orange, and black replacing any natural cast shadow. The overall composition is energetic but firmly balanced, opposing the small upright floral cluster and broad round disk to large rough-edged rectangles of blue, pink, black, and white.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形半抽象绘画把一小簇黄花和一块橙色大圆盘置于粗犷饱和色块之间。深钴蓝色域覆盖左侧和上部背景的大部分。最左侧高高的芥黄色带被划痕、蓝色笔迹和一条厚黑水平带打断。右半部一块宽阔粉色矩形在中央元素后升起，边缘部分被刮开，露出下面蓝色。中部不规则黑色与深海军蓝笔迹水平延伸，形成沉重的暗条。细深绿色茎条从下方中央伸出，托着几朵鲜黄橙色花，花心是小黑点。厚实简化的花瓣部分被周围颜料打断，因此花朵处于可辨静物与纯色笔迹之间。右侧中部是一块大而平坦的橙色圆盘，略粗糙的边缘擦过粉色和深色区域。其下，一片浅白色块铺到右下。蓝色涂抹、淡线划痕和细窄黑色重音切进白色，使它不成为崭新矩形。左下回到强烈蓝色，橄榄绿色茎形在其前方下垂。画面明显经过层叠：拖曳颜料、刮开补丁、起伏不匀的透明度与近似铅笔的引导线留在宽阔色域里。这里没有很深的透视，也没有可读文字；所有元素都贴近同一个绘画平面。光线图形化且均匀，白、黄、橙与黑的明度反差取代自然投影。整体构图活跃而牢固，以小小直立花群和宽圆盘对照大面积粗边的蓝、粉、黑与白矩形。
style_prompt_en: The semi-abstract painting is assembled from bold, high-contrast fields with edges that are scraped, dragged, and repeatedly overpainted. Cobalt blue, hot pink, mustard yellow, orange, black, and chalky white remain distinct even where layers collide. Large rectangles and rounded masses provide a stable structure, interrupted by thinner vertical strokes and small uneven marks. Some areas are nearly opaque; others reveal ghost lines and earlier colors through scuffs and thin paint. Hard divisions alternate with frayed boundaries, allowing the eye to sense both graphic design and physical handling. Illumination is flat and color-driven, with bright white and yellow areas acting as highlights against heavy dark bands. Spatial depth is shallow, but overlay and differences in opacity create rich surface depth. The overall effect is impulsive yet composed, with tactile revision marks giving simple geometry its vitality.
style_prompt_zh: 这种半抽象绘画由大胆高反差色域拼起，边缘经过刮擦、拖曳和反复覆盖。钴蓝、热粉、芥黄、橙、黑与粉笔白即使在色层碰撞处仍然分明。宽大矩形与圆润大块提供稳定结构，较细的竖向笔迹和小而不匀的痕迹从中打断。部分区域近乎不透明，另一些区域则从擦痕和薄颜料下透出幽灵般的旧线与前层颜色。硬朗分界与散乱边缘交替，让观看者同时感到图形设计和实际手工操作。光照平坦，由色彩驱动；明亮白色和黄色区域成为沉重深色带前的高光。空间纵深很浅，覆盖与透明度差异却造出丰富表面深度。整体效果冲动而仍有布局，触手可感的修订痕迹让简单几何充满活力。
theme_en: Yellow flowers beside a large orange disk amid rough blue and pink color blocks
theme_zh: 黄色花朵与橙色圆盘置于粗粝的蓝粉色块之间
name: Bruce McLean
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
